$comment: QA-07 shared contract vectors — single source of truth for the four client packages (acf-cli, mcp-server, autocodeflow-node-sdk, autoflow-sdk). Envelope source: apps/admin-api/src/common/interceptors/response.interceptor.ts. Vectors are append-only (published clients assert on old vectors); changing behavior is a breaking contract change -> bump $schemaVersion and ship all four ends together. See README.md for the full contract description and consumption instructions.

non200SuccessCode.$comment: code mirrors HTTP status; 201 must unwrap exactly like 200

emptyObject.$comment: no data key at all -> not an envelope

arrayBody.$comment: arrays are never envelopes (node-sdk rule; py dict-guard equivalent)

statusRange.$comment: anything in success[] must resolve; anything in failure[] must throw/inspect body — no status-specific bypass

errorBody.name: envelope-style single message

raw.message: Invalid or expired execution callback token

errorBody.detail: Invalid or expired execution callback token

errorBody.name: class-validator message array

message: status must be one of the following values

errorBody.detail: executionId must be a UUID; status must be one of the following values

errorBody.name: no detail at all
errorBody.$comment: empty detail -> callers must keep raw status/text, never swallow

knownHeuristicEdge.name: code+message+data on an entity payload (full envelope shape)
knownHeuristicEdge.$comment: documented edge: a payload carrying the FULL envelope shape (code+message+data) is indistinguishable from an envelope and is unwrapped by every end — entities must never carry all three keys. Strict form (node-sdk/py-sdk require all three; cli/mcp accept data+(code|message)) is the common denominator; changing it is a breaking contract change

knownDivergence.name: data+message WITHOUT code
knownDivergence.$comment: QA-07 audit finding: cli/mcp use the looser data+(code|message) heuristic, node-sdk/py-sdk require the strict code+message+data triple. admin-api always sends code, so real traffic is unaffected. Do NOT rely on the loose form — flagged for future unification (breaking change requires four-end same-batch release)
